results.title: De Novo Biosynthesis of Antidepressant Psilocybin in Escherichia coli.
results.evidence: Here, we demonstrated the de novo biosynthesis of psilocybin in E. coli from glucose.

results.title: Convergent biosynthesis of psilocybin in an ectomycorrhizal lineage.
results.evidence: We show that Inocybe species independently evolved the enzymes for psilocybin biosynthesis through distinct gene clustering and horizontal transfer events.

results.title: Enzymatic synthesis of psilocybin and related analogues.
results.evidence: Here we demonstrate the in vitro synthesis of psilocybin using recombinant PsiD, PsiK, and PsiM enzymes with high substrate conversion.

results.title: Heterologous biosynthesis of magic mushroom compound psilocybin in yeast.
results.evidence: Heterologous biosynthesis of magic mushroom compound psilocybin in yeast.

results.title: Magic pathways: the genes and enzymes of psilocybin biosynthesis.
results.evidence: In this article, we focus on the metabolic processes leading to psilocybin in the fungal cell and present the biosynthetic enzymes, their structures, and the reactions catalyzed.

results.title: Genome-based optimization of psilocybin and N,N-dimethyltryptamine biosynthetic pathways in E. coli using CRISPR-associated transposases.
results.evidence: We successfully engineered an E. coli strain for the high-level production of psilocybin using CRISPR-associated transposases to balance metabolic flux.

results.title: Biocatalytic production of psilocybin using engineered fungal enzymes.
results.evidence: Biocatalytic production of psilocybin using engineered fungal enzymes.

results.title: Total synthesis of psilocybin and related tryptamines.
results.evidence: We report an efficient and scalable four-step chemical synthesis of psilocybin starting from 4-hydroxyindole with an overall yield of 62%.

results.title: Enhancing cGMP signaling with psilocybin reduces head twitch and restructures synapses.
results.evidence: Mice were treated with psilocybin to examine behavioral head twitch responses and downstream intracellular cyclic GMP accumulation.

results.title: Psilocybin enhances conditioned place preference learning in planarians.
results.evidence: Planarians were acutely exposed to psilocybin to assess reward-related behavior and environmental preference conditioning.

results.title: Direct Quantitation of Psilocybin and Psilocin by 1H and 31P NMR.
results.evidence: A quantitative NMR method was developed for the simultaneous determination of psilocybin and psilocin in commercial fungal extracts.

results.title: Factors Associated with Intentions to Use Psilocybin for Mental Health in Relation to Psychotherapy.
results.evidence: We surveyed 1,200 individuals regarding their attitudes toward natural psilocybin and willingness to undergo psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy.

results.title: Safety and efficacy of psilocybin-assisted therapy for alcohol use disorder: Open-label extension.
results.evidence: Participants received two oral doses of psilocybin in conjunction with psychotherapy during a 12-week trial period, resulting in significant reduction in heavy drinking days.
